walkthroughs.body_html:
International Relations: Changing Superpower Relations 1941-2010 — a core area of GCSE History.

Working through it builds the schema you need: the key terms, how they connect, and how to use them together.

International Relations: Changing Superpower Relations 1941-2010 brings together several ideas you need to use as a set, not in isolation.

Lock in the vocabulary first, then practise pulling the ideas together to answer real questions.

Use the activities in this adventure to build familiarity with International Relations: Changing Superpower Relations 1941-2010.

Practise vocabulary, calculations and free-text questions to lock in the learning.

The killings only began after Germany lost the Battle of Stalingrad.
